title: Jay White & Gedo turn against Okada
summary: Jay White uses his place in CHAOS to move toward power, then takes Gedo away from Okada. The Rainmaker must face both a rising rival and the betrayal of his long-time mentor.

chapters.title: Gedo chooses the Switchblade
chapters.result: White and Gedo turn against Okada.
chapters.context: The split strips Okada of his familiar support structure and gives White an influential ally for his rise.

chapters.title: White defeats Okada in the Dome
chapters.context: The victory shows that the turncoat can beat the man he betrayed, rather than relying only on the shock of Gedo’s defection.
